name: Cellular Jail (Kala Pani)
category: Heritage: Historical Sites, National Memorials
tagline: Colonial freedom sagas at Cellular Jail, ficus-draped ruins of Ross Island & crescent coral coves

Featuring seven radial wings extending from a central watchtower, the complex now stands as a sacred national memorial overlooking the azure waters of the Bay of Bengal.

name: Veerabhadra Swamy Temple & The Hanging Pillar
category: Spiritual / Heritage · UNESCO Tentative List, 1530 AD Vijayanagara Architecture, Legendary Pillar Defying Gravity

World-renowned for its architectural marvel—the "Hanging Pillar"—which does not rest on the floor; cloth and thin paper can be passed entirely underneath. Also features the giant 7-hooded stone Nagalinga carved from a single granite boulder.

In ancestral Mizo mythology, Rih Dil was revered as the sacred passage through which departed souls journey to Mitthi Khua (the celestial realm of the dead).

name: Kohima War Cemetery & Garrison Hill
category: Heritage: Historical Sites, WWII Memorials

summary: Constructed on the terraced battlefield of Garrison Hill where Allied and Japanese troops clashed in ferocious close-quarter combat in 1944. Maintained by the Commonwealth War Graves Commission, it contains 1,420 bronze graves and bears the world-famous Kohima Epitaph: "When You Go Home, Tell Them Of Us And Say, For Your Tomorrow, We Gave Our Today."
